# owner: platform
from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student

# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    if not students:
        raise ValueError("no students given")
    for pupil in students:
        if not pupil.email:
            raise ValueError(
                f"no email for {pupil.display_name}"
            )
    ordered = sorted(
        students, key=lambda pupil: pupil.display_name
    )
    name_wide = max(len(p.display_name) for p in ordered)
    sect_wide = max(len(p.section) for p in ordered)
    return [
        f"{pupil.display_name:<{name_wide}}  "
        f"{pupil.section:<{sect_wide}}  {pupil.email}"
        for pupil in ordered
    ]
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.models import Student


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            Student("2", "Zed", "Al", "B", "al@x.org"),
            Student("1", "Adams", "Bea", "A1", "bea@x.org")
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows, [
            "Adams, Bea  A1  bea@x.org",
            "Zed, Al     B   al@x.org"
        ])

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        pupil = Student("1", "Adams", "Bea", "A")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Adams, Bea"):
            contact_rows([pupil])

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            contact_rows([])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF
